import sympy as sp
d=sp.pi/180
r=sp.nsimplify(sp.N(1-sp.sin(32*d)**2+1/(1+sp.tan(58*d)**2),30),tolerance=1e-20)
opts={'A':sp.sqrt(3),'B':sp.Rational(1,2),'C':1,'D':sp.N(sp.sin(32*d),30)}
assert abs(sp.N(r-opts['C']))<1e-15
for k in 'ABD': assert abs(sp.N(r-opts[k]))>1e-6

method: Max of a sinθ + b cosθ
check_code:
import sympy as sp
th=sp.symbols('th')
f=2*sp.sin(th)+3*sp.cos(th)
c=sp.solve(sp.diff(f,th),th)
r=max(sp.simplify(f.subs(th,v)) for v in c)
opts={'A':9,'B':sp.sqrt(17),'C':sp.sqrt(11),'D':sp.sqrt(13)}
assert sp.simplify(r-opts['D'])==0
for k in 'ABC': assert sp.simplify(r-opts[k])!=0

for k in 'BCD': assert r!=opts[k]
